narrative.overview: Librune reads like a physical folio: warm cream paper, an ink-black spine of UI chrome, and a gold-on-dark cover accent that echoes traditional bookbinding. Depth comes from tonal layering; only content objects carry a soft resting shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment palette in light mode, near-black ink in dark mode.
Cinzel for titles, Literata for reading, Plus Jakarta Sans for UI chrome only.
Radius graduated by role: controls rounded-sm, covers rounded-xl, sheets rounded-t-3xl.
Gold is a book-object colour, never UI chrome.

rules.name: The Boundary vs Decoration Rule
rules.body: --input is every control boundary; --border and --divider are decorative only.

rules.name: The Cover Accent Rule
rules.body: cover-dark and cover-gold are for covers, the mark and the app tile.

rules.name: The Ink Inversion Rule
rules.body: Primary is always the theme's ink-on-paper extreme; use --primary.

rules.name: The Selection Accent Rule
rules.body: selected is the only color that means the active choice.

rules.name: The Ramp-Only Rule
rules.body: Font sizes come from the --text-* scale only.

rules.name: The Resting Lift Rule
rules.body: Covers carry .elevated-soft at rest, not only on hover.

dos: Do keep controls at the modest end of the radius scale (rounded-sm).
Do use the --primary token for anything that must invert between themes.
Do use selected only for active or checked state.
donts: Don't add a drop shadow to bottom sheets.
Don't introduce a cold neutral gray.
Don't put gold on a light ground or alter the mark.
